basis_note: Split-adjusted: past bars are adjusted for splits only, NOT for dividends. This is TradingView's default chart basis (its 'Adjust data for dividends' option is off by default).
former_code_note: HFCK is the former NSE code of the issuer that now trades as HFCB (HF Group Plc / HFCB Group Plc). This file is a historical alias only: the canonical, served series is static_data/history/NSE_HFCB.json, which carries the same bars and the rebrand sessions. Removed 16 non-trade bars dated 2026-09-14..2026-10-05 (15 zero-volume bars at o0.1 h0.2 l0.1 c0.1 and one 2026-10-05 bar repeating the 2026-07-24 close); they were junk, not trades. Do not read this file as a second series for HFCB.

flat_marks.rule: a flat bar (o=h=l=c) with volume 0 is the exchange's carried close for a session that did not trade; it is marked halt=true and v=0, never rescaled. This marker is metadata only - no price changes.
